source_snapshot.procedure: Set all IPv4 NIC ports to Static-IP, enter each BIOS IPv4 Network Configuration menu, set Configured Enabled and inspect information; the loop text says repeat steps 1-2; source also clears logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All IPv4 Network Cards' information should be correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; correctly requires BIOS operator work but provides no per-port addresses, mapping, conflict checks, independent recovery or rollback.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; constrains writes to approved per-port values, requires independent OOB recovery, duplicate/conflict checks, save/re-entry evidence and baseline restoration.

historical_reviews.deepseek: The manual boundary fits, but `set IPv4 NIC ports` is unsafe without exact values and cannot be treated as permission to modify every interface blindly.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Classification and high-risk network controls are accepted; all-card inspection is bound to an explicit per-port transaction matrix.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code searches found no duplicate variant or earlier completed record; preceding IPv6 row is read-only and must not be used as a write precedent.
historical_reviews.v3_1: BIOS preboot IPv4 settings can affect PXE/preboot access and may overlap management networks, so each card/port needs identity, address-ownership, conflict, recovery and restoration evidence.

original_test_intent: Have a qualified operator apply the owner-approved Static-IP/Configured values to each intended BIOS IPv4 NIC port, verify all displayed information after save/re-entry and avoid address conflict or management lockout.
original_method: Bind every NIC/card/port to BDF/slot/MAC and an approved IPv4 tuple; preserve an independent OOB path and baseline; mutate one approved port at a time in BIOS, save/re-enter, capture and compare all displayed fields, perform only approved reachability/conflict checks, then restore or record the authorized final state before moving on.
manual_activity: The network owner supplies and approves each port/address tuple; a qualified operator performs BIOS writes, save/re-entry, evidence capture, reachability checks and restoration while preserving independent OOB access.
required_inputs: Complete NIC/card/port topology with BDF/slot/MAC mapping
Per-port Static-IP, prefix/netmask, gateway, DNS and Configured values actually exposed by BIOS
Address ownership, VLAN/subnet and duplicate/conflict validation
Baseline and rollback values per port
Qualified BIOS/network operator and per-step approval
safety_requirements: Never configure all ports from a generic instruction without an approved matrix
Do not change a management or production path without isolated recovery
Validate address ownership and absence of conflicts before save
Change one named port at a time and re-identify it by stable topology
Do not clear dmesg, syslog or SEL
Stop on link/OOB loss, duplicate address, wrong port, failed save or unexpected routing
No automatic retry; restore through the approved OOB path
agent_execution_scope: Support read-only topology, address and reachability prechecks
Coordinate but do not claim BIOS UI control
Compare displayed values against the approved tuple
Perform only approved non-disruptive conflict/reachability checks
Track restoration/final state and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve every target port/address tuple, order, final state and recovery
Verify independent OOB and network ownership
Resolve conflict/connectivity failures and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its NO/manual classification is correct, but no per-port value, stable mapping, conflict gate or rollback is provided.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Manual operator: for each approved port, capture baseline, set only its authorized Static-IP and Configured values, save/re-enter, verify every displayed field and approved reachability, then restore or record final state before the next port.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Static-IP, Configured Enabled, all-card inspection and 20/20-minute estimates remain; the malformed repeat-step reference does not reduce the all-card criterion, and log clearing is prohibited.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL PER-PORT APPROVAL-GATED IPV4 CONFIGURATION MATRIX
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a transaction per port containing topology identity, baseline, approved address tuple, ownership/conflict check, BIOS before/set/save/re-entry values, bounded reachability and rollback/final-state evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds per-port values, stable identity, conflict prevention, independent recovery and restoration instead of a blind all-port write.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: IPv6 read-only inventory from the prior row cannot prove IPv4 configuration; one port's successful save cannot stand for all ports.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Preboot IPv4 configuration semantics and persistence may differ by NIC firmware; wrong addresses can break PXE or overlap production/management networks.

project_override_considerations: A Project may leave approved static values as final state, but must record that decision per port. OS network tools are supporting evidence and do not replace BIOS save/re-entry; OOB recovery must remain independent of modified interfaces.
expected_evidence: SUT/BIOS and complete NIC/port topology plus redacted per-port IPv4 matrix
Address ownership/conflict checks, independent OOB proof and approvals
Per-port BIOS baseline, changed, saved/re-entered and final captures
Per-port expected-versus-observed field and bounded reachability comparison
Missing/extra/wrong-port, conflict and link/OOB findings plus preserved events
Rollback/approved final state and engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Criteria clearly require all IPv4 cards, and the Procedure defines Static-IP plus Configured Enabled. Its final loop cites only steps 1-2 rather than all inspection steps, but the all-card scope remains explicit; this is a procedure defect handled without reducing coverage, not an incompatible target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual workflow is safely defined once the owner supplies the full per-port matrix, network ownership, independent OOB path, operator and rollback.

review_improvement: Converts an unsafe all-port instruction into identity-bound per-port transactions with conflict avoidance, recovery and complete save/re-entry evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A static address is not merely a displayed value: it claims a subnet identity and can reroute or isolate preboot traffic. Stable port mapping, address ownership and independent recovery must precede each write, while all-card completeness is verified only after every authorized transaction is reconciled.
